items.title: George Russell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: The day the principal called me in to high school to tell me that they were kicking me out of school, and I had to go to a psychiatrist for wearing high draped pants and what – as the song goes, “high draped parts and sheets that are oh so mellow.” [sic: He wears high draped pants. Stripes are really yellow. But when he starts in to love me, he is so fine and mellow.”]

My Uncle Joe passed away – had passed away for months before me getting kicked out of school. During the dialog between the principal of the school and myself, he said, “And furthermore, your father asked how you were doing in school.” I said, “My father?” “Yes, yes, your father. He’s living in” – what’s the name of that city, near Cincinnati, on the high river? He was in – he was a music teacher in one of these schools.
